ledger.why: who competes: the trials name no villager (no game skill matches these contestants)
a small ('modest') game-scaled tech reward on the constructive outcomes (A1, A3, B1, B2); reputation is told only (rule 7)

intro.name: The trial
intro.text: The contestants face a puzzle that seems to contradict itself: a liar's statement, a divided heap of grain, an endless sequence of smaller steps, or a riddle about a ship rebuilt plank by plank.

choices.label: Allow contestants to explain why the puzzle is misleading.

a1.text: A contestant spots a hidden assumption and resolves the puzzle to thunderous applause.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives tech

a2.text: The judges accept a clever answer until a child finds a counterexample. The prize is withheld.

a3.text: Two scholars reach different answers because they interpret a word differently. Both are declared correct under their stated assumptions.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives tech

b1.text: A quiet thinker demonstrates that the riddle cannot be answered without defining its terms.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives tech

b2.text: The contestants argue until dusk, then agree that recognizing a genuine uncertainty is progress.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives tech

b3.text: One villager solves the paradox by eating the grain used to demonstrate it. The philosophers are furious; the farmers are delighted.

p1.text: A judge from the other community praises the winning rival despite pressure from (judge.his/her) own supporters. The crowd slowly applauds.

p2.text: An accusation of favoritism forces the judges to disclose their criteria; the disputed result is upheld, reversed, or declared a tie.

p3.text: Competitors from both communities secretly practice together and publicly acknowledge each other when the results are announced.
